# CassetteCat

> CassetteCat is a free, open-source music player for Android, Windows and Linux, made by CaffeineLabs. It plays local music files, streams from your own Navidrome, Jellyfin or other Subsonic server, shows synced lyrics and plays internet radio. The Android app and the desktop app work on their own, and can be paired over Wi-Fi so the phone controls the computer. It has no ads, no analytics and no account. Licensed under GPL-3.0.

## Android app

- Requires Android 8.0 or later. Get it from [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.caffeinelabs.cassettecat) or the APK from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/samyyy2311/CassetteCat/releases/latest). Obtainium can track GitHub releases for automatic updates. The F-Droid listing is pending.
- Local library: scans device storage and SD cards for FLAC, MP3, AAC, OGG, Opus, WAV and ALAC, with folder filters and tag support.
- Self-hosted streaming: Jellyfin and any Subsonic-compatible server (Navidrome, Gonic, Airsonic, LMS), with offline downloads.
- Synced lyrics from embedded LRC and ID3 tags or LRCLIB, with a lyrics editor.
- Equalizer with AutoEq headphone correction profiles.
- Internet radio through Radio Browser, searchable by name, genre or country.
- Android Auto, Android Automotive OS and a Drive Mode for the car.
- Listening Record with top songs, artists and albums, full history and a monthly Rewind poster.
- Scrobbling to Last.fm, ListenBrainz and Libre.fm.
- Home screen widget, Listening Room (beta) for synced playback across devices on the same Wi-Fi, M3U playlist import and export, and backup and restore.
- Page: https://cassettecat.caffeinelabs.in/android

## Desktop app

- Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit): [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NXNRR95X3K0), or the installer or portable .zip from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/samyyy2311/CassetteCat-Desktop/releases/latest).
- macOS: in development, not available yet.
- Linux on x86_64 and ARM64: AppImage, .deb, .rpm, Flatpak and .tar.gz.
- Plays FLAC, MP3, AAC, ALAC, OGG, Opus and WAV, and streams from Navidrome, Gonic, Airsonic or Jellyfin.
- Synced lyrics from .lrc files, tags or LRCLIB, with tap-along timing for plain lyrics.
- Ten-band equalizer with AutoEq, gapless playback, crossfade and ReplayGain.
- Tag editor for many songs at once, Listening Record with monthly and yearly Rewind, and scrobbling to Last.fm, ListenBrainz and Libre.fm.
- Mini player, system tray controls, media keys and keyboard shortcuts. Offline Blackout Mode turns off every internet request.
- Page: https://cassettecat.caffeinelabs.in/desktop

## Using both

Pairing happens over the local Wi-Fi by approving the phone on the computer. The connection is encrypted and stays on the local network. Once paired, the phone controls playback on the computer, moves the song and queue between devices, browses and streams the computer's library, shares one Listening Record, keeps likes and playlists in sync, and keeps a daily backup on the computer.

## Privacy

No ads, no analytics SDKs, no tracking IDs and no user accounts. Listening history and playlists stay on the user's devices. Server passwords are encrypted with the Android Keystore on Android and kept in the system's credential store on desktop. Online lookups for lyrics, artwork and metadata are optional and can each be turned off.

## Not available

There is no iPhone or iPad version.
